From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kayla Torres <kayla@talentbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Panel grid scheduling: three-track virtual loop for REQ-1248

Team —

We have a strong candidate for REQ-1248 (Samuel Kim). Kayla sent over availability and the resume — attached. Samuel is a senior SWE with infra + perf background; we want to run a three-track virtual loop (System Design / Coding / Infra & Reliability) with a 30–40 minute buffer for the debrief immediately after.

Proposal (all times PDT):
- Track A (System Design): 9:30–10:15
- Track B (Coding - pair): 10:30–11:30 (40m interview + 20m buffer)
- Track C (Infra/Reliability): 12:00–12:45
- Debrief (evaluators only): 13:00–13:30

Notes / asks:
- Marissa: can you take Track A? We need someone to drive design and assess architecture tradeoffs.
- Karthik: would you own the coding pair (Track B)? If not, suggest an alternate (we can swap with Laura).
- Irene: infra track (Track C) — can you cover reliability and deployment questions?
- All: if you have hard constraints or prefer different ordering (e.g., coding before design), flag them now.

Attachments: samuel_kim_resume.pdf, virtual-loop-runbook-v2.pdf (contains evaluator rubric and candidate prep notes).

If everyone confirms today I’ll lock calendar invites and ask Kayla to send the candidate confirmation + pre-read checklist.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Blake
Sr. Engineering Manager — Platform
Redwood Inference

Jordan —

Thanks for the outline. I can take Track A (System Design) but prefer a 45m slot (more time for the API/scale discussion). If we shift A to 9:20–10:05 and move the coding block to 10:30–11:20 that gives a cleaner 10-minute break between.

One more ask: for Track B (pair coding), I’d like Karthik + a second interviewer who can own test quality (Laura volunteered, should be fine). Karthik, can you confirm you’re available 10:30–11:20?

Also calling out that I’ll need the design prompt by EOD tomorrow so I can prep concrete follow-ups. If Jordan / Product can drop the prompt in the runbook doc, I’ll iterate the rubric.

Marissa
